subject: 🏃 Wednesday — Heavy Strength (Wk 2)
html:
Tomorrow: Wed Heavy Strength at Cañada College — Week 2 of 12, Phase 1 Foundation & Durability. 73 days to race day.

Yesterday's track session was textbook — every 800m rep landed 6:40–7:00 with a negative split, HR peaked at just 167 on the Polar H10, and knee was 1/5. That's a strong signal heading into tomorrow's lift. Warm up with foam roll quads/IT band (1 min each), 10 glute bridges, quadruped hip CARs (3 each leg), 10 bodyweight squats, and 10 RDL pattern reps with the empty bar.

The session:

ExerciseWeightSets × RepsCue
Back Squat155 lb4 × 63-sec eccentric, hips break first
Romanian Deadlift155 lb4 × 6Straps on — grip won't be the limiter this time
Reverse NordicBodyweight3 × 10Target ~60° depth (up from 45° last week), glutes locked
Standing Calf Raise40 lb/hand DBs4 × 10Full ROM on step, 2-sec hold at top, 3-sec lower

All four lifts stay at last week's weights — everything rated Good on May 6, so the load is right. The big unlock today is the lifting straps: RDL jumped from 3×4 to 4×6 at 155 because your grip won't cap the set anymore. If you don't have the straps yet, drop RDL to 135 and do clean sets rather than fighting the bar. Reverse Nordic: push the lean-back toward 60° but bail before any sharp patellofemoral bite.

Focus cue: Slow eccentric on every rep — count a full "one-Mississippi, two-Mississippi, three-Mississippi" on the way down. The 3-sec descent is doing real work for tendon resilience and motor control. Don't rush it.

Prep tonight: Lay out gym clothes and straps. Hydrate well — you ran 8 miles of track work today. Aim for bed by 10. Thursday is a 6-mile progression run (4 mi easy / 2 mi @ 7:15–7:25 threshold), so tomorrow's lift feeds directly into that.
